description: The extends below names Merkleye's org policy explicitly rather than relying only on Renovate's config inheritance. Inheritance is already applying it -- PR #9 arrived here labelled `dependencies`, on branch `renovate/go-minor`, as `chore(deps):`, on the Monday schedule, for an *indirect* Go dependency that Renovate skips by default, all while this repository had no config file at all. The explicit reference makes that dependency visible in the tree and survives the org-level inheritance setting being changed or unset.

The cost is that the policy is applied twice while inheritance is also on: packageRules concatenate rather than replace, so the 22 org rules arrive from the inherited layer and again from this preset, giving 45 instead of 23. The duplicates are identical and idempotent, and the go-yit rule below still resolves last, so behaviour is unchanged -- it is redundancy, not conflict.

One risk worth knowing if Renovate ever stops running for this repository: org-inherited-config.json carries a hostRules entry templating {{ secrets.GH_PACKAGES_TOKEN }}. Secrets resolve from global and inherited config; if that name is not resolvable at repository scope, Renovate aborts this repo's run with `config-validation: Unknown secrets name`. If that happens, the durable fix is to split org-inherited-config.json in Merkleye/renovate-config into a policy preset with no secrets plus the hostRules block, and extend the policy half from here.

Hold github.com/dprotaso/go-yit at its 2022 digest. Newer digests move it from gopkg.in/yaml.v3 to go.yaml.in/yaml/v4, which then does not compile against its only consumer in this module graph: github.com/vmware-labs/yaml-jsonpath@v0.3.2, unmaintained since 2021-06-15 and still on yaml.v3. Both upstreams that could fix it are already at their newest releases -- oapi-codegen v2.8.0 and speakeasy-api/openapi v1.25.1 -- so no combination of versions takes the update and still builds. Full analysis and reproduction: https://github.com/Merkleye/mcp-server/pull/9

The scope is one package on purpose. go-yit is reached only through oapi-codegen, which is a go.mod tool directive, so this is build-time only -- it is never linked into merkleye-mcp and carries no runtime or security exposure. Disabling it costs nothing operationally and nothing else in the graph is affected.

This rule is declared directly rather than in the preset above, so it is evaluated after every inherited and extended rule -- including the org's rule enabling gomod indirect dependencies, which it needs to override for this one package.

Remove this rule when any one of these becomes true: yaml-jsonpath is maintained again or migrates to yaml/v4; speakeasy-api/openapi drops its yaml-jsonpath dependency; oapi-codegen drops or replaces the overlay loader; or this repository moves off oapi-codegen.
